cases.name: Sara Christine West
cases.about: She loved tea parties, dolls and the movie Cinderella.
cases.narrative: He sexually assaulted her digitally and she began screaming. He got a knife, stabbed her and bit her breast and thigh. Then he dragged her down the stairs, put her in the bathtub, cut off her breast and slit her throat. He also cut her body from her pelvis to her neck and further stabbed her inner organs. He also shot her in the head. He put her body in trash bags and threw her down an embankment.
